allowed_umos.description: Exact QQ session UMO allowlist. Use the complete value logged by AstrBot, such as private_qq_bot:GroupMessage:<group_openid> or private_qq_bot:FriendMessage:<user_openid>; an empty list denies all.

natural_language_enabled.description: Recognize direct natural-language Codex requests. Group messages require an @ mention; allowlisted private/C2C messages are already addressed.

auto_complex_enabled.description: Automatically route clear engineering and multi-step research requests to Codex in read-only mode.

semantic_routing_enabled.description: Let the chat model delegate an unfamiliar but clear complex request through a guarded no-argument tool.
